# Consumer sentiment improves in August's final print as year-ahead inflation expectations cool

Aug 28, 2026, 10:03 AM ETBy: Mary Christine Joy, SA News Editor

Consumer Sentiment Index improved to 51.7 from the initial print of 51.0, but remained below the July level of 55.2, according to data released by the University of Michigan Survey of Consumers on Friday.
results.title: Consumer sentiment improves in August's final print as year-ahead inflation expectations cool

results.content:
## Key Takeaways

1.   The University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index final reading fell to 51.7 in August, a 6.3% decrease from July.

2.   The Current Economic Conditions Index fell 5.3% to 51.9, while the Consumer Expectations Index fell 7.0% to 51.5.
3.   Year-ahead inflation expectations decreased from 4.0% from 4.2% in July.
